instruction: Configure Thunderbird to automatically schedule and send delayed emails from schedule-mail@gmail.com at specific future times without using any third-party extensions or manual scheduling.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because Thunderbird does not have built-in scheduled/delayed send functionality without extensions.
